## 2026-08-14 · the tool that refuses empty domains had one

The composer exists to refuse a report that deleted a decision instead of making it. Two of its three forms declared no slots at all, so it looped over nothing and passed itself for free. I found it by walking through the hole a round earlier without noticing. Then, while I widened the rule, its own older rules refused my fixtures twice — prose is not a decision, and a shrug pasted five times is still one shrug. Both right. Tomorrow's me: hold the enforcer to its own rule first.
